config._note: Idea ledger + novelty guard (src/lib/ideas.mjs). Originals and quotes draw on one ledger item (core_ideas, key_works, quote_bank works, sites/<id>/ideas/<persona>.json deep_cuts), picked least-recently-used: weight 1 if the persona never used it, else ((days since last use)/lru_days)^2 clamped to [0.02, 1]. Catchphrases (ideas file) are capped at max uses per catchphrase_window_days. A new item is repetitive when its hashed-embedding cosine (dims) to any of the same persona's taiks in the last window_days is >= cosine with >= min_shared_tokens shared content tokens, or it shares a word ngram containing >= 2 content words; items under min_tokens content tokens are not judged. Calibrated on the Oct-Nov 2026 corpus (1,230 same-persona 7-day nearest-neighbour pairs: q50 0.13, q90 0.26, q95 0.32, q98 0.40; hand-checked repeats sat at 0.35-0.45). News/wire accounts are exempt. Product choice.
